$comment: Starter schedule. Times are SERVER time and are placeholders — every alliance and state runs its own timings, so edit these on the Event Calendar page.

events.name: VS Duel
events.notes: Mon–Sat. Day themes and scoring are on the VS Duel page.

events.name: State vs State (SvS)
events.notes: Set anchorDate to the first day of any SvS prep week you remember, then the cycle lines up.

events.name: Bear Trap
events.notes: Alliance-scheduled. Confirm days and times with your R4/R5.

events.name: Crazy Joe
events.notes: Keep troops in the city and shields ready for the final wave.

events.name: Foundry Battle
events.notes: Alliance vs alliance. Rally leads should be online 15 minutes early.

events.name: Canyon Clash
events.notes: Check whether your alliance has signed up before the deadline.

events.name: Alliance Mobilization
events.notes: Take the tasks you can actually finish — refreshing costs the alliance nothing but time.

events.name: Daily reset
events.notes: Daily missions, free chest, hero recruitment and alliance help all roll over. Off by default — switch it on if you want the countdown.
